structural_audit.scope: all persisted source_claim rows; catalog versions checked separately
structural_audit.quality_label_interpretation: validated is a persisted historical label; not evidence that every value was compared with an official original
limits: No new temporal publication certification performed.
No aggregate row count is treated as completeness of required metric/dimension/date matrix.
Multiple claims for one observation can be legitimate versions or providers; no blanket duplicate defect claim.

provenance_audit.interpretation: Official URL#sha256 gives direct byte-level linkage. TuShare textual references do not contain a per-claim raw-response hash; smoke manifests and normalized hashes supply batch evidence, not by themselves an exact raw-response or publication-time proof.

query_definitions.counts: SELECT name FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table'; SELECT count(*) FROM <allowlisted table>
query_definitions.claim_versions: SELECT metric_id, definition_version, certification_status, quality_status, count(*) AS claim_count FROM source_claim GROUP BY metric_id,definition_version,certification_status,quality_status
query_definitions.derived: SELECT metric_id,formula_version,as_of_mode,count(*) AS observation_count,min(as_of_cutoff) AS first_as_of_cutoff,max(as_of_cutoff) AS last_as_of_cutoff,min(computed_at) AS first_computed_at,max(computed_at) AS last_computed_at FROM derived_observation GROUP BY metric_id,formula_version,as_of_mode
query_definitions.identity_multiplicity: SELECT metric_id,count(*) AS identities_with_multiple_claims,sum(n-1) AS additional_claims,max(n) AS max_claims_per_identity FROM (SELECT metric_id,observation_id,count(*) AS n FROM source_claim GROUP BY metric_id,observation_id HAVING count(*)>1) GROUP BY metric_id
query_definitions.active_model: SELECT m.* FROM model_version m JOIN active_model a USING(model_version_id)
query_definitions.projection: SELECT p.* FROM projection_set p JOIN current_projection c USING(projection_set_id)
query_definitions.datasets: SELECT dataset_name,document_json FROM analytical_dataset WHERE projection_set_id=?
query_definitions.retrieval_counts: SELECT channel,outcome,count(*) AS attempt_count FROM retrieval_attempt GROUP BY channel,outcome
query_definitions.retrieval_failures: SELECT metric_id,channel,json_extract(safe_metadata_json,'$.error_type') AS error_type,count(*) AS attempt_count FROM retrieval_attempt WHERE outcome='source_failed' GROUP BY metric_id,channel,error_type
query_definitions.public_time_patterns: Computed from claims: public/release/fetched timestamp null, equality, chronological comparison; equality is a diagnostic, not proof of origin.
query_definitions.structural_checks: Computed for each claim against metric_definition(metric_id,definition_version): finite reported value, unit membership, dimension key equality/nonblank string values, ISO periods and timezone-aware times. Definition versions are not collapsed; observation multiplicity is not treated as invalid duplication.
query_definitions.public_time_sql: SELECT count(*) AS n,sum(public_available_at IS NULL) AS public_null,sum(release_at IS NULL) AS release_null,sum(public_available_at=fetched_at) AS public_equals_fetched,sum(public_available_at=release_at) AS public_equals_release FROM source_claim
query_definitions.required_structure_sql: SELECT count(*) AS n,sum(value_state='reported_value' AND value IS NULL) AS numeric_missing,sum(unit IS NULL OR trim(unit)='') AS unit_missing,sum(NOT json_valid(dimensions_json)) AS invalid_dimensions_json,sum(period_start>period_end) AS reversed_period FROM source_claim
query_definitions.metric_source_presence_sql: SELECT metric_id,count(*) AS n,count(DISTINCT observation_id) AS identities,count(DISTINCT period_end) AS periods,min(period_start),max(period_end) FROM source_claim GROUP BY metric_id
query_definitions.exact_reference_join_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM source_claim WHERE source_reference IN (SELECT source_reference FROM artifact_reference)
